def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells8=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==8]
    gcells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,8)]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells8); c0=min(c for _,c in cells8)
    S=max(r for r,_ in cells8)-r0+1
    gr0=min(r for r,_ in gcells); gc0=min(c for _,c in gcells)
    gs=max(r for r,_ in gcells)-gr0+1
    # check glyph bbox is square and full
    gw=max(c for _,c in gcells)-gc0+1
    assert gs==gw and S%gs==0, (gs,gw,S)
    s=S//gs
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in cells8:
        mr,mc=(r-r0)//s,(c-c0)//s
        out[r][c]=g[gr0+gs-1-mc][gc0+mr]  # rotate glyph 90 CW to get mini
    return out

def bbox_cells(grid, values):
    """The cells whose value is in `values`, plus (min_row, min_col, side) of their square bounding box."""
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j] in values]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells); c0=min(c for _,c in cells)
    side=max(max(r for r,_ in cells)-r0, max(c for _,c in cells)-c0)+1
    return cells,(r0,c0,side)

import ast, textwrap

def clean_variant(name, sig=None):
    """Pick the latest candidate def for `name` that compiles standalone; strip scaffold."""
    best=None
    for mt,b in all_variants(name):
        s=b.strip()
        # cut anything after the final return/raise line that isn't part of the def (scaffold)
        # find the def, take lines until a line at col 0 that's not def/comment/decorator/continuation
        lines=s.split('\n')
        keep=[]; started=False
        for ln in lines:
            if ln.startswith('def ') or ln.startswith('class ') or ln.startswith('@'):
                if started: break
                started=True; keep.append(ln); continue
            if not started:
                continue
            if ln and not ln[0].isspace():
                break
            keep.append(ln)
        src='\n'.join(keep).rstrip()
        # strip trailing triple quotes remnants
        while src.endswith("'''") or src.endswith('"""'):
            src=src[:-3].rstrip()
        try:
            tree=ast.parse(src)
            fns=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,))]
            if not fns or fns[0].name!=name: continue
            if len(fns)!=1: continue
            # docstring: ensure no stray triple quotes inside body lines (scaffold tell)
            if src.count('"""')%2 or src.count("'''")%2: continue
            if any(isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value.value,str) and n is not tree.body[0] for n in tree.body): continue
            if len(tree.body)!=1: continue
            params=[a.arg for a in fns[0].args.args]
            if sig is not None:
                want=[p.split(':')[0].split('=')[0] for p in re.findall(r"(\w+)",sig)] if False else None
            if best is None or len(src)>=0:
                best=(mt,src,params)
        except SyntaxError:
            continue
    return best

def sig_params(sigstr):
    inner=sigstr.strip('()')
    if not inner: return []
    ps=[]
    for p in inner.split(','):
        p=p.strip().split('=')[0].split(':')[0].strip()
        if p: ps.append(p)
    return ps

from lib import block_count_map, one_color_lines, majority_color, rare_color

def transform(grid):
    """Per separator-delimited block: 1 where the block holds exactly 2 of the marker color, else the background color."""
    rows, cols = one_color_lines(grid)
    sep = {grid[rows[0]][0]} | ({grid[0][cols[0]]} if cols else set())
